newsitem.title: UK: Quadrant mulls move into UK domestic gas market.
newsitem.headline: Quadrant mulls move into UK domestic gas market.

text.p: British gas supplier Quadrant Gas, part of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group, is considering entering the UK domestic gas market, which is in the process of being opened up to competition.
"It is an area which we are going to examine," said a Shell spokeswoman.
Shell said earlier it had agreed to buy to raise its stake in Quadrant to 100 percent by buying the 50 percent holding previously owned by Esso UK, part of Exxon Corp.
"This move was made to allow different strategies and approaches to gas marketing," the spokeswoman said.
Quadrant is keen to have a strong presence in the UK market for industrial and commercial users where it already has a six percent market share.
Shell said the acquisition of Esso UK's stake in Quadrant would not affect its North Sea exploration and production joint venture with Exxon.
"There are no implications for the upstream business," the spokeswoman said.
